title: The book cannot be opened (fault injected)
note: If opening the database or updating it throws, a recovery screen replaces the app, in the same plain block as the crash screen: "The book could not open", the letters are safe on this phone, "Try again, or restart the phone.", and two actions: Try again and Export what's readable. No delete, reset or rebuild exists here. Reached only by a preview-only switch (?fault=launch-once); on a phone it follows a failed database open or update.
